properties.description: The CI gate on the real binary: probes generated from every served schema (a wrong type at every typed location, an unknown key in every closed object, a value outside every enum, an empty item wherever an item has required fields, every required top-level field) must each be refused naming the tool and the path, quoting the field's description or saying it has none; plus the reconnect advice over a session and never through the --call door.
properties.name: refusal_speaks.py
